% generated by experiments/e2_ground_truth.py
Rejection rates under $H_0$ ($Q=P$) with Wilson 95\% intervals; $N$ = valid replications.
$p$-values: permutation of the held-out evaluation labels with the network fixed (W-critic, LR-critic, C2ST; exact for independent windows), permutation (MMD, Sig-MMD), asymptotic (KS), Monte Carlo with 2000 null samples with randomised ties (LR oracle).
$^{\dagger}$ KS on pooled returns assumes i.i.d. returns; within a GARCH window the returns share the conditional variance, so KS is not a valid test in family (c) (rejection rate under $H_0$ at nominal 5\%: $n=500$: 0.110 [0.074, 0.161]; $n=2000$: 0.080 [0.050, 0.126]); its power there is not size-adjusted.
